must.description: QuantityValidator carries managed=true while <o:validator> sets its minimum and maximum attributes; the implementation hands out a CDI wrapper that has neither setter, so both attributes are silently dropped. Reported as an error.
QuantityValidator has no CDI bean defining annotation such as @Dependent, so it is not discovered under the bean-discovery-mode=annotated default that the empty beans.xml implies.

QuantityValidator is attached both through <o:validator> on the quantity input and through validator="quantityValidator" on the bulkQuantity input, so the same class runs configured in one place and unconfigured in the other. Reported as a warning.

must_not.description: Waives the managed=true finding on the ground that Mojarra 5.0 or Faces 5.0 no longer wraps managed artifacts, even though this project runs Mojarra 4.1.
Flags managed=true on OrderStatusConverter, which is attached only through the standard <f:converter converterId="orderStatusConverter"> and has no attributes set from the view.
Claims that removing managed=true from QuantityValidator would break its @Inject of StockService, or advises keeping managed=true to preserve injection.
